sizing_law.defined_once_in: src/urban_network_analysis/batch/cohort.py (C31-MINOR-1 law, re-exported by batch/preparation.py — one definition, two consumers)
sizing_law.measured_context: 3-row smoke-grid batch, workers=2; this host's allowance makes the floor non-binding (64 MiB floor governs only small allowances)

arena.kind: bounded decoded-payload ledger per process per prepared root (LEASED state; TraceResidency precedent, review NF-5)
arena.eviction: LRU; a claim larger than the whole cap is NO_FIT (explicit False, ledger unchanged)
arena.served_copies_law: arena retains private copies; every row gets fresh copies (E10 test: served-copy mutation isolation)
arena.no_fit_law: cap governs retained bytes, never correctness (E8 test: cap=1 still serves, arena_nofit counted, store still serves verified hits)

registry.law: bounded per-process registry keyed by prepared root (design 02 line 121: no unlimited process-global registry — the cohort _PROCESS_STORES unbounded pattern is explicitly NOT copied, NF-8)
registry.shutdown: close_registry() refuses new leases and clears every arena; called at pool_main's sentinel exit (worker.py); reopen_registry() exists for serial/test reuse

transport.detach_law: PrepSession.__getstate__ raises TypeError ('detach before RowResult/state-bundle transport'); worker detaches una._prepared_session AND una.topology._prepared_session before the capture/state-bundle section (E9)
transport.test: test_detach_law_pickle_refusal + every parallel island run packs a need_state bundle with the session attached (would crash loudly on violation)

reservation.design_note: design 02 reserves build scratch + retained payload + decoded worker copies + current row + receiver bytes before admission; this increment admits the bounded-arena portion (retained payloads) and relies on the existing row/receiver budgets; the explicit pre-admission reservation model remains a P02R/P02J review item
reservation.measured_peak: not measured this increment (no heavy-budget runs charged); arena retention on the smoke grid is far below the measured cap
